question: Under what condition of careful examination may a teacher grant this life-extending knowledge?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined
Examination should be done carefully and always
Only then may the gift be given
inference: After thorough examination, the teacher may give this long-life-bestowing knowledge.
uncertainties: dadyāccirajīvitam fuses verb and object; cirajīvitam may refer to long life or a related boon
plain_english: Having always examined him thoroughly, one may give him this gift of long life.
